postContentHtml:
This is the first post in the blog-vir demo site. Everything you see here was generated from a directory of markdown files.

How it works

The blog-vir CLI reads every .md file under a posts directory, renders it to HTML, and writes a set of JSON files into the Vite static directory. The browser then fetches only the JSON it needs for the current page.

Why JSON

Shipping one JSON file per post keeps the initial page small. A blog with a thousand posts loads exactly as fast as a blog with three.
